title: S4 'can I arrive Thursday morning?' — LIVE Model Studio NL extraction + LIVE planning against RECORD Atlas evidence (honest sandbox truth)

boundaries.note: natural-language traveller request interpreted by LIVE Model Studio into the frozen ChangeRequest schema; zod-validated, fail-closed on ambiguity
Model Studio planning for the change-request case through the provider-neutral model client
planner-requested corridor evidence goes through the RECORD-mode Atlas adapter; sanitized recordings persisted

steps.description: Traveller asks in natural language for a Thursday-morning arrival; LIVE Model Studio extracts the request into the frozen ChangeRequest schema (schema validation is deterministic; the model never mutates state)

body.text: Hi! I have things to wrap up in Chiang Mai on Wednesday. Can I arrive by 2026-10-01T09:00:00+08:00 instead? My first session is the search chat on Thursday afternoon.

assert.description: the request came from interpretation, not a pre-structured target
the model maps arrive-by text to a trip-window adjustment
no binding language: the model keeps the request a preference, not an instruction
a recovery case opens for the request
the resolver records implications derived from policy evidence

steps.description: LIVE Model Studio planning: the model requests corridor evidence (RECORD-mode Atlas), then authors arrival candidates; deterministic viability judges every candidate against the programme arrival constraints

assert.description: the planning loop completed against live model + recorded corridor evidence
the evidence request is a flight search
the RECORD Atlas adapter supplied corridor offers
the planner proposes arrival candidates from the corridor offers
a Thursday-morning arrival deterministically violates the programme arrival buffer: available offers can still be rejected
hard-infeasible candidates can never win: no best strategy is ranked
the case advanced through the planning stage

steps.description: Observe the recovery case after planning: policy/authority outcome is the honest ceiling — nothing viable, nothing to approve or execute

assert.description: the case belongs to the requesting traveller's trip
the evaluated options remain visible on the case
